title: "It's All Just One Big Lie" — Madoff's Confession

lines.say: December tenth, two thousand eight. Bernie Madoff tells two senior employees his business is a fraud.
lines.show: December 10, 2008. Bernie Madoff tells two senior employees his business is a fraud.

lines.say: According to prosecutors, he said he was finished, that he had absolutely nothing, and that it was all just one big lie.

scene.q: finished … absolutely nothing … it's all just one big lie

lines.say: He put the losses at fifty billion dollars, at least.
lines.show: He put the losses at $50 billion, at least.

lines.say: And he said he had two to three hundred million left, which he planned to pay to selected employees, family, and friends.
lines.show: And he said he had $200–300 million left, which he planned to pay to selected employees, family, and friends.

lines.say: The next morning, the FBI arrested him.
Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.

label: SWORN
